headline: Viet An Swings Back to Loss of Over VND 72 Billion in First Half; Liabilities Exceed VND 33.7 Trillion
summary: Viet An Investment reported a loss of over VND 72 billion in the first half of 2026, after two years of profit. Liabilities rose above VND 33.7 trillion, more than 2.3 times the year-earlier level.
why: Viet An is a Vietnamese investment and trade company, and rising liabilities relative to earnings matter for lenders and shareholders assessing its financial strain.
